# WordBite Solutions

> WordBite Solutions covers Instagram and WhatsApp automation for social media agencies and service businesses: lead capture, bookings, reminders and client reporting, with tool rankings and industry playbooks.

WordBite Solutions is part of the Socialfeed Technology Pvt Ltd publishing network. Socialfeed Technology Pvt Ltd also builds Tadlo AI, which appears in our rankings. Full disclosure: https://wordbite.solutions/disclosure/

## Instagram for businesses

- [Instagram lead generation for service businesses](https://wordbite.solutions/instagram-lead-generation-service-businesses/): How service businesses turn Instagram comments and DMs into bookings: content that invites enquiries, instant DMs, qualification questions and handoff to booking.
- [How to take appointment bookings through Instagram DMs](https://wordbite.solutions/appointment-booking-instagram-dm/): How service businesses take bookings through Instagram DMs: keyword-triggered booking links, slot questions, confirmations, no-shows and when to move to WhatsApp.
- [An Instagram DM funnel for local businesses](https://wordbite.solutions/instagram-dm-funnel-local-business/): How local businesses such as cafés, salons, gyms and shops use an Instagram DM funnel to turn local followers into walk-ins: offers, codes, directions and timing.
- [How to deliver lead magnets through Instagram DMs](https://wordbite.solutions/lead-magnet-delivery-instagram/): How service businesses deliver guides, brochures and checklists by Instagram comment keyword: choosing the lead magnet, the DM, email capture and follow-up.
- [How businesses capture emails from Instagram](https://wordbite.solutions/capture-emails-instagram-business/): How businesses capture emails from Instagram DMs and a link-in-bio page, handle consent, and hand leads to a CRM or email platform without losing context.
- [How to reply faster to Instagram enquiries](https://wordbite.solutions/respond-faster-instagram-enquiries/): How businesses cut Instagram response times: instant auto-replies for common questions, keyword answers, routing to staff, business hours and measuring speed.
- [Instagram automation for real estate](https://wordbite.solutions/instagram-automation-for-real-estate/): How real estate developers, brokers and agents use Instagram automation: brochure delivery, property enquiries, site visit bookings and lead capture by keyword.
- [Instagram automation for coaching institutes](https://wordbite.solutions/instagram-automation-for-coaching-institutes/): How coaching institutes use Instagram automation for admissions enquiries, demo class sign-ups and batch details, and where fee reminders belong instead.
- [Instagram automation for clinics](https://wordbite.solutions/instagram-automation-for-clinics/): How clinics use Instagram automation for appointment booking, timings and location questions, while keeping all medical advice out of automated messages.
- [Instagram automation for salons and spas](https://wordbite.solutions/instagram-automation-for-salons-spas/): How salons and spas use Instagram automation for bookings, price menus, offers and filling empty slots, and where rebooking reminders belong.
- [Instagram automation for gyms and fitness studios](https://wordbite.solutions/instagram-automation-for-gyms-fitness-studios/): How gyms and fitness studios use Instagram automation for trial passes, class schedules and membership enquiries, and where renewal reminders belong.
- [Instagram automation for restaurants and cafés](https://wordbite.solutions/instagram-automation-for-restaurants-cafes/): How restaurants and cafés use Instagram automation to send menus, take table booking requests, share offers and answer hours and location questions.
- [Instagram automation for travel agencies](https://wordbite.solutions/instagram-automation-for-travel-agencies/): How travel agencies use Instagram automation for package enquiries, sample itineraries and lead capture, and where payment reminders belong.
- [Instagram automation for event organisers](https://wordbite.solutions/instagram-automation-for-event-organisers/): How event organisers use Instagram automation for ticket links, line-up and venue questions, early-bird waitlists and updates, and where reminders belong.
- [Instagram automation for hotels and homestays](https://wordbite.solutions/instagram-automation-for-hotels-homestays/): How hotels and homestays use Instagram automation for room enquiries, direct booking links, check-in information and guest reviews.
- [Instagram automation for B2B and SaaS companies](https://wordbite.solutions/instagram-automation-for-b2b-saas/): How B2B and SaaS companies use Instagram automation for demo requests, gated resources and light lead qualification before handing leads to sales.
- [Instagram automation for financial advisors](https://wordbite.solutions/instagram-automation-for-financial-advisors/): How financial advisors use Instagram automation for consultation bookings and educational resources while keeping automated messages free of advice and promises.
- [Instagram automation for NGOs and nonprofits](https://wordbite.solutions/instagram-automation-for-ngos/): How NGOs use Instagram automation for donation links, volunteer sign-ups and event information, and how to keep donors updated through the right channels.
- [How to sell Instagram DM automation as an agency service](https://wordbite.solutions/sell-dm-automation-as-a-service/): How agencies and freelancers package Instagram DM automation as a service: what to include, deliverables, onboarding clients and choosing a tool honestly.
- [How much agencies should charge for DM automation](https://wordbite.solutions/dm-automation-pricing-for-agencies/): How agencies price Instagram DM automation: setup fees, monthly retainers, performance elements, and how tool pricing models affect your margin and client trust.
- [Client onboarding checklist for Instagram automation](https://wordbite.solutions/agency-onboarding-checklist-automation/): A step-by-step onboarding checklist for agencies starting Instagram automation for a client: access, account type, connection, content, testing and the first report.

- [How agencies run WhatsApp campaigns for clients](https://wordbite.solutions/whatsapp-campaigns-for-clients/): A process for agencies running WhatsApp campaigns for clients: brief, opt-in check, template approval, client sign-off, cost preview, sending and reporting.
- [The best WhatsApp tools for agencies](https://wordbite.solutions/best-whatsapp-tools-agencies/): WhatsApp API tools for agencies running client accounts, compared on client ownership of the WABA, markup to explain, cost preview and team access. Tadlo AI ranks first.
- [Click-to-WhatsApp ads: a practical guide](https://wordbite.solutions/click-to-whatsapp-ads-guide/): How Click-to-WhatsApp ads work, Meta's free entry point window, what to reply when ad chats arrive, and how to follow up, with tool gaps stated.

- [WhatsApp automation for travel agencies](https://wordbite.solutions/whatsapp-automation-for-travel-agencies/): How travel agencies use WhatsApp for package enquiries, itineraries, documents and payment links, with payment reminders run from the booking system rather than the chat tool.
- [WhatsApp automation for event organisers](https://wordbite.solutions/whatsapp-automation-for-event-organisers/): How event organisers use WhatsApp for ticket links, attendee questions and event updates to opted-in attendees, with reminders sent from the ticketing platform or as broadcasts.
- [WhatsApp automation for hotels and homestays](https://wordbite.solutions/whatsapp-automation-for-hotels-homestays/): How hotels and homestays use WhatsApp for booking enquiries, check-in information and guest requests, with review requests sent as opted-in broadcasts rather than automations.
- [WhatsApp automation for B2B and SaaS companies](https://wordbite.solutions/whatsapp-automation-for-b2b-saas/): How B2B and SaaS companies use WhatsApp for demo requests, lead qualification questions and customer updates, with nurture sequences run from the CRM.
- [WhatsApp automation for financial advisors](https://wordbite.solutions/whatsapp-automation-for-financial-advisors/): How financial advisors use WhatsApp for consultation booking and administrative replies, while keeping investment advice and account details out of automated messages.
- [WhatsApp automation for NGOs and nonprofits](https://wordbite.solutions/whatsapp-automation-for-ngos/): How NGOs use WhatsApp for donor updates, volunteer sign-ups and event information, sent as opted-in broadcasts, with costs and consent explained.
